summary.text: This resolution recognizes the 95th anniversary of the Detroit-Windsor Tunnel (an underwater international border crossing that connects the cities of Detroit, Michigan; and Windsor, Ontario).

title: Recognizing the 95th anniversary of the Detroit-Windsor Tunnel and its enduring significance to international trade, economic development, and cross-border relations between the United States and Canada.
